newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: South Asian port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South Asian port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, June 10 - Chittagong - 24 Vessels in port of which 5 containers, 4 general cargo, 1 cement clinker, 2 sugar, 2 fertiliser, 4 under repair, 1 seeds, 1 salt, 1 food grain, 3 tankers. 25 Vessels due by 17/6 of which 14 containers, 6 general cargo, 2 cement, 1 fertiliser, 1 seeds. No berthing delays.

INDIA, June 10 - Bombay - Labour gang shortages because of holidays and summer vacation. Six vessels loading at berth, 8 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchor, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 8 waiting to discharge. 3 Vessels under repair, 3 awaiting orders. Berthing delays, container/general cargo vessels 1-2 days, bulkers 5-6 days. Calcutta - Seven vessels loading at berth, 27 discharging at berth, 1 vessel bunkering. Vessels due (3 coking coal, 8 products tankers, 6 containers, 2 crude oil, 3 coal, 1 logs, 1 pulses, 1 petcoke, 1 limestone, 1 bagged urea, 1 lash barge).

Cochin - No labour problems. One vessel loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 4 under repair/dry docked (1 general cargo, 2 ferries at CSL jetty, 1 naval vessel in dry-dock). 10 Vessels due with up to 1 day delay expected. Chennai (Madras) - No labour problems. Five vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 1 vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting to discharge. 39 Vessels due (6 coal, 11 general cargo, 1 fertiliser, 2 barytes, 15 containers, 2 scrap, 1 panamax, 1 lube oil) with following delays expected, coal/coke 2-3 days, fertiliser/scrap 5-6 days, no delays for iron ore/containers.

Mormugao - No labour problems. Two vessels loading at anchorage, 4 discharging at berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 4 waiting to discharge. 5 Vessels under repair/dry dock, 1 waiting court clearance. 10 Vessels due (1 caustic soda, 1 phenol, 1 panamax, 1 petroleum, 6 ore) with the following delays, ore 7-8 days, no delays for other vessels. Kandla - Three vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth, 2 discharging in stream, 10 waiting at anchorage to load, 8 waiting to discharge. 2 Vessels under arrest, 3 tankers, 13 vessels waiting. 16 Vessels due with 8-10 days delay expected. Mangalore - No labour problems. Eight vessels loading/discharging at berth. 1 Vessel under arrest, 9 due with 2-3 days delay expected.

Jawaharlal Nehru - No labour problems. Two fertiliser/raw materials vessels discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge fertiliser/raw materials/food grain. 8 Vessels due (2 fertiliser/urea/dap, 6 tankers/iron ore) with the following delays, urea 8-10 days, other fertilisers 15-18 days, tankers/iron ore 6 days. Paradip - No labour problems. Three vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting to discharge. 6 Vessels due, with 4-5 days delay expected. Tuticorin - No labour problems. Five vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting to discharge. 8 Vessels due, with 2-3 days delay expected. Visakhapatnam - Five vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth. 10 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth, 10 waiting to load at inner harbour ber. 34 Vessels due with 7-8 days delay expected.

PAKISTAN, June 9 - Karachi - Three vessels loading at berth (molasses, clinker), 2 loading/discharging containers, 3 discharging at berth (crude oil, general cargo, sulphur). 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (rice, molasses), 3 to discharge (general cargo, containers). 3 Vessels awaiting orders. 8 Vessels due with following delays, general cargo/containers up to 24 hours, tankers up to 3 days. Port Qasim - Two vessels discharging at berth (palmoil, fuel oil). 1 LPG vessel waiting at anchorage to discharge.

SRI LANKA, June 10 - Colombo - Labour shortages persist. Delays being experienced in berthing/unberthing on break bulk and conventional vessels. 14 Vessels loading at berth (8 containers, 6 essential services). 19 Discharging at berth (2 bagged sugar, 11 containers, 1 bagged flour, 1 essential services, 1 lpg, 1 bulk clinker, 2 general cargo). 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (1 containers, 1 lpg). 5 Vessels bunkering, 1 under repair, 1 dry-docked, 6 under arrest, 8 awaiting orders, 1 changing crew. 14 Vessels due (6 container feeders, 6 bulk cement, 1 general cargo, bagged flour) with the following delays expected, general cargo 1-2 days, container feeders 1 day. Galle - One vessel discharging at berth. Trincomalee - One vessel loading at berth.
